BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: <!>TEST这就是异象证伪会吗？
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: Is this the TEST, the disproving of anomalies?

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: <!>TEST我倒要看看是什么东西
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: I'd like to see what TEST is.

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: <!>TEST我倒要看看是什么东西
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: I'd like to see what TEST is.

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: <!>TEST我倒要看看是什么东西
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: I'd like to see what TEST is.

Description.SourceString: 前往纳库佩达公园的<blue>许愿池</>，解救遇到麻烦的<blue>塔吉多</>。
Description.LocalizedString: Go to the <blue>Wishing Pool</> at Nacupeda Park and rescue <blue>Taygedo</>.

Description.SourceString: 和<blue>塔吉多</>聊聊发生的事
Description.LocalizedString: Talk to <blue>Taygedo</> about what happened

PanelDescription.SourceString: <blue>塔吉多</>恢复了平静，和他在公园散散心吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: <blue>Taygedo</> has calmed down. Take a relaxing walk with him in the park.

Description.SourceString: 前往<blue>白鲸书店</>
Description.LocalizedString: Go to <blue>Moby-Dick Bookstore</>

PanelDescription.SourceString: <blue>塔吉多</>有问题想请教你，前往<blue>白鲸书店</>和他聊聊吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: <blue>Taygedo</> has a question he'd like to ask you. Head to <blue>Moby-Dick Bookstore</> and have a chat with him.

Description.SourceString: 前往<blue>白鲸书店二楼</>寻找塔吉多想要的书
Description.LocalizedString: Go to the <blue>Second Floor of Moby-Dick Bookstore</> to find the book Taygedo wants

PanelDescription.SourceString: 跟随前往<blue>白鲸书店二楼</>，寻找他要的书。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Follow him to the <blue>Second Floor of Moby-Dick Bookstore</> and look for the book he wants.

Description.SourceString: 和<blue>塔吉多</>交谈
Description.LocalizedString: Talk to <blue>Taygedo</>

PanelDescription.SourceString: 找到了塔吉多想要的书，和他交流一下吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: You found the book Taygedo wanted. Go talk to him about it.

Description.SourceString: 前往<blue>伊波恩</>的餐区获取<blue>仓库钥匙</>
Description.LocalizedString: Go to <blue>Eibon</>'s dining area to get the <blue>warehouse key</>

PanelDescription.SourceString: 塔吉多决定把伊波恩仓库的备用钥匙送给你，去收下这份礼物吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Taygedo has decided to give you the spare key to Eibon Warehouse. Go ahead and accept this gift.

Description.SourceString: 和<blue>塔吉多</>交谈
Description.LocalizedString: Talk to <blue>Taygedo</>

PanelDescription.SourceString: <blue>塔吉多</>想和你分享它的秘密计划，去伊波恩的<blue>仓库</>听听他的想法吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: <blue>Taygedo</> wants to share his secret plan with you. Go to Eibon's <blue>Warehouse</> and hear what he has in mind.

Description.SourceString: 前往<blue>伊波恩后院</>寻找<blue>早雾</>
Description.LocalizedString: Go to <blue>Eibon's Backyard</> to find <blue>Sakiri</>

PanelDescription.SourceString: 去伊波恩后院，和早雾一起制作烤牛奶吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Go to Eibon's Backyard and make baked milk together with Sakiri.

Description.SourceString: 前往<blue>伊波恩大厅</>与<blue>早雾</>汇合
Description.LocalizedString: Go to <blue>Eibon Lobby</> and meet up with <blue>Sakiri</>

PanelDescription.SourceString: 去伊波恩大厅，帮早雾吧散架的书页重新拼起来吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Go to Eibon Lobby and help Sakiri piece the scattered book pages back together.

Description.SourceString: 跟随<blue>早雾</>前往<blue>伊波恩二楼</>
Description.LocalizedString: Follow <blue>Sakiri</> to the <blue>Second Floor of Eibon</>

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 你不跟他们说明情况，就这样自己默默做这些事吗？
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: So you're just quietly handling all this without telling them what happened?

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 说这说那的好麻烦。
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: All this talking is such a pain.

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 而且事情能解决就行了，知不知道的都无所谓。
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: Besides, as long as the problem gets fixed, it doesn't matter who knows about it.

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: ……感觉比起娜娜莉，你更像是老大。
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: …You seem more like the boss than Nanally does.

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 喂喂，这话别让娜娜莉听到！
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: Hey, hey! Don't let Nanally hear you say that!

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 要让她知道了又得念叨半天什么一把手二把手的，有得烦呢。
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: If she finds out, she'll lecture me forever about who's really in charge. That would be such a pain…

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 娜娜莉……
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: Nanally…

PanelDescription.SourceString: 和早雾一起前往伊波恩二楼，将书放回原处……
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Go to the Second Floor of Eibon with Sakiri and put the books back where they belong…

Description.SourceString: 跟随<blue>早雾</>前往<blue>伊波恩二楼</>
Description.LocalizedString: Follow <blue>Sakiri</> to the <blue>Second Floor of Eibon</>

PanelDescription.SourceString: 娜娜莉也在二楼，她似乎有些心事……
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Nanally is also on the second floor, and she seems to have something on her mind…

Description.SourceString: 前往<blue>广场附近</>和<blue>早雾</>汇合
Description.LocalizedString: Go to <blue>Plaza</> and meet up with <blue>Sakiri</>

PanelDescription.SourceString: 去广场附近，和早雾一起试着寻找小狗的主人吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Go to Plaza and work with Sakiri to try and find the dog's owner.

Description.SourceString: 前往<blue>叮咚怪咖所</>与店长<blue>妮蒂亚</>交谈
Description.LocalizedString: Go to <blue>Jingle Wrangle</> and talk to owner <blue>Nydia</>

PanelDescription.SourceString: 或许，叮咚怪咖所的店长会对这条小狗的主人有印象？
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Perhaps the owner of Jingle Wrangle might remember the dog's owner?

Description.SourceString: 与<blue>法帝娅</>彻夜长谈
Description.LocalizedString: Talk with <blue>Fadia</> for the night

Description.SourceString: 去A.R.P.T.S酒吧和法帝娅见面
Description.LocalizedString: Meet Fadia at A.R.P.T.S bar

PanelDescription.SourceString: 等待时间到晚上10点，去A.R.P.T.S酒吧和法帝娅见面。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Wait until 10 PM, then meet Fadia at A.R.P.T.S bar.

Description.SourceString: 与<blue>法帝娅</>彻夜长谈
Description.LocalizedString: Talk with <blue>Fadia</> for the night

PanelDescription.SourceString: 醉意攀上眼角，法帝娅的故事跌进摇晃的酒杯里，她的眼底似有星海。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Fadia gets drunk and begins to open up, and you can see an ocean of stars reflected in her eyes…

Description.SourceString: 跟随法帝娅到<blue>河边</>看日出
Description.LocalizedString: Follow Fadia to the <blue>riverside</> to watch the sunrise

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 法帝娅，泥，泥，泥……
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: Fadia, you, you, you…

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 鉴定师，你已经喝得大舌头了哦？
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: Appraiser… You're already slurring your words, aren't you?

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 窝……窝没醉呀。
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: I'm… I'm not drunk!

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 嗯嗯，你最清醒了！
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: Uh-huh, you're the most sober person here!

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 泥，泥执行任务，战斗时……还是要顾惜自己森命的。法帝娅。
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: You… when you're on a mission, in fights… you still… gotta take care of yourself. Fadia.

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 鉴定师，你看，太阳出来了。
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: You… when you're on a mission, in fights… you still… gotta take care of yourself. Fadia.

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 天亮了。
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: It's dawn.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 和法帝娅去河边散步，醒醒酒，吹吹风，顺便看一场日出……
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Take a walk by the river with Fadia to sober up. Get some fresh air, and watch the sunrise together…

Description.SourceString: 和<blue>法帝娅</>在晨雾中谈心
Description.LocalizedString: Have a heart-to-heart with <blue>Fadia</> in the morning mist

PanelDescription.SourceString: 半梦半醒间，那些真挚的关怀……像只醉鸟落在行人的肩上。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Although half-asleep, you can feel her sincere concern shine through… as gentle as a tipsy bird roosting on your shoulder.

Description.SourceString: 在<blue>水菱湖边</>找到法帝娅
Description.LocalizedString: Find Fadia by <blue>Caltrop Lake</>

PanelDescription.SourceString: 水菱湖边，法帝娅似乎已等待多时。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: By Caltrop Lake, Fadia seems to have been waiting for quite some time.

QuestName.LocalizedString: A Path Lined with Blooming Cherry Trees

Description.SourceString: 跟随法帝娅在湖边散步
Description.LocalizedString: Follow Fadia for a walk by the lake

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 自从鉴定师加入伊波恩，明里暗里摆平了不少异象事件。
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: Ever since you joined Eibon, you've been handling quite a few anomaly cases, both openly and behind the scenes.

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 托你的福，管理局给的假期也多起来了。
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: Thanks to you, the Bureau's been giving us a lot more vacation time lately.

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 要是攒一攒，说不定还能去海岛度个假呢。
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: If I save them up, I might even be able to take a nice island vacation.

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 呃，法帝娅一天不调侃人，大概会无聊到失眠吧。
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: Uh, you'd probably get so bored that you couldn't sleep if you were to go a day without teasing someone.

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 是呢，所以得不停地找乐子。
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: Exactly, so I have to keep finding ways to entertain myself.

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 说起来……你身上似乎有股药味。
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: Speaking of which… you seem to have a medicinal smell about you.

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 法帝娅，你受伤了吗？是不是又不要命地去战斗了……
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: Fadia, are you hurt? Did you go throwing yourself into battle recklessly again…

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 哎呀，原来鉴定师这么在意我？
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: Oh my, so the Appraiser cares about me this much?

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 可惜伤口已经消失了……要亲自检查下吗？
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: Too bad the wound's already healed… Want to give me a personal inspection?
Ah… I… no…

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 放心吧，我没受伤。
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: Don't worry, I'm not hurt.

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 我的异能是可以分散痛觉，只要我想，战斗造成的伤口也能在瞬间愈合。
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: My ability lets me disperse pain sensations. As long as I will it, wounds from battle can heal instantly too.

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 你闻到的药味其实是猫薄荷。
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: That medicinal smell you picked up is actually catnip.

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 是我去猫猫激推馆，想更彻底地享受猫师傅们的抓背服务，才故意涂的。
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: I applied it on purpose when I went to Kitty Bakery. I wanted to fully enjoy the scratching services from the little biscuit makers.

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 咦，这里也有猫师傅。
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: Oh, there are more little biscuit makers here too.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 樱花树下，和法帝娅并肩漫步。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Take a walk with Fadia under the cherry trees.

Description.SourceString: 与法帝娅一起撸猫
Description.LocalizedString: Pet cats with Fadia

PanelDescription.SourceString: 和法帝娅一起撸猫，咪看上去毛茸茸的，但爪爪却异常锋利。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Pet the cats with Fadia. The kitties look so fluffy and soft, but their claws are surprisingly sharp!

Description.SourceString: 与<blue>法帝娅</>交谈
Description.LocalizedString: Talk to <blue>Fadia</>

PanelDescription.SourceString: 甘拜下风，法帝娅真的很能吃辣。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: That's a resounding defeat! Fadia really can handle her spice.

Description.SourceString: 和法帝娅在<blue>家具店</>碰面
Description.LocalizedString: Meet Fadia at the <blue>furniture store</>

PanelDescription.SourceString: 和法帝娅在家具店碰面，准备帮她挑选要赔偿给市民的家具。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Meet Fadia at the furniture store to help her choose furniture as compensation for the citizen.

Description.SourceString: 跟随法帝娅逛家具店
Description.LocalizedString: Follow Fadia around the furniture store

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 鉴定师，你来了。
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: Appraiser, you have arrived.

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 让我看看……选些什么家具好呢，得将她的「狗窝」打扮得焕然一新才行。
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: Let me see… what furniture should I pick? I need to spruce up her little "doghouse" and give it a complete makeover.

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 呀，你不会觉得我说话刻薄吧，鉴定师？
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: Oh, you don't think I'm being too harsh, do you, Appraiser?

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 有，有点。
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: A… a little.

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 哈哈。但她真的住在「狗窝」里哦。
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: Haha. But she really does live in a kennel, you know.

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 她住的房子……是用郊外一个废弃狗屋改造的，条件简陋，附近也没什么人。
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: The house she lives in… it's converted from an abandoned kennel on the outskirts of town. Those are pretty rough conditions, and no one around for miles.

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 只有不断上门骚扰的异象，和我这种……被异象吸引去的「战斗狂魔」。
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: Just Anomalies constantly showing up to cause trouble, and people like me… battle maniacs drawn in by the Anomalies.

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 经常有异象去捣乱吗？
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: Do Anomalies show up to cause trouble often?

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 是啊。团三郎会去偷食物，长明灯组队去偷电，家里值钱的东西么……也都被包包蚊搬空了。
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: Yeah. Danzaburou steals her food, the Eternal Lamps team up to steal electricity, and anything valuable in the house… well, the Pouch Mosquitoes cleaned all that out too.

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 这些听起来都是低级异象，不像是你会感兴趣的程度啊？
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: These all sound like low threat Anomalies. Doesn't seem like the kind of thing that would interest you?

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 之前你可是觉得，连五级异象都不够刺激。
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: You used to think even Class 5 Anomalies weren't exciting enough.

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 为什么会突然盯上那里呢？
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: Why the sudden interest in that place?

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: ……唔，跟那些小家伙，是算不上什么激烈交手。不过偶尔来场「按摩SPA」，也不错~
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: …Mm, fighting those little guys hardly counts as intense combat. Though an occasional "massage session" isn't too bad either…

PanelDescription.SourceString: 陪法帝娅在店里闲逛时，听到了关于狗屋的故事。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: While browsing the store with Fadia, you heard a story about the kennel.

Description.SourceString: 与<blue>法帝娅</>交谈
Description.LocalizedString: Talk to <blue>Fadia</>

PanelDescription.SourceString: 法帝娅提议，再去二楼看看。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Fadia suggests checking out the second floor.

Description.SourceString: 去<blue>二楼</>和法帝娅交谈
Description.LocalizedString: Go to the <blue>second floor</> and talk to Fadia

PanelDescription.SourceString: 逛完了大半个店，但法帝娅永远觉得下一件更心动。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: You've browsed through most of the store, but Fadia doesn't want to stop checking things out!

Description.SourceString: 与法帝娅和店主进行交谈
Description.LocalizedString: Talk to Fadia and the shop owner

PanelDescription.SourceString: 从家具店老板口中，得知了关于狗屋的真相……
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: You learned the truth about the kennel from the shop owner…

Description.SourceString: 与<blue>法帝娅</>交谈
Description.LocalizedString: Talk to <blue>Fadia</>

PanelDescription.SourceString: 法帝娅的家族往事中，尘封着一段不为人知的秘密。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Fadia's family history hides a buried secret…

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: （说起来，安魂曲的年纪和早雾、埃德嘉他们差不多吧。）
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: (Come to think of it, Lacrimosa's probably around the same age as Sakiri and Edgar.)

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: （伊波恩有阿德勒先生尽心照顾着，安魂曲却是独自生活吗……）
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: (Eibon has Adler taking such good care of her, but Lacrimosa is living all by herself…)

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: （那边站着的老人……大概就是安魂曲的房东吧。）
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: (That elderly person standing over there… must be Lacrimosa's landlord.)

Description.SourceString: 听听<blue>格思里</>想说些什么
Description.LocalizedString: Listen to what <blue>Gethrie</> has to say

PanelDescription.SourceString: 这位热情的赛车手执意要将爱车转让给你，但她的言行举止中，似乎透着几分蹊跷……
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: This enthusiastic racer insists on giving her beloved car to you, but there's something suspicious about her words and behavior…

Description.SourceString: 等待格思里的联络（<blue>第二天20点</>）
Description.LocalizedString: Wait for Gethrie to contact (<blue>8:00 PM the Next Day</>)

PanelDescription.SourceString: 格思里自顾自地去报名比赛了，并承诺会为你安排最佳观赛席位……全然不管你是否同意。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Gethrie went ahead and signed up for the race on her own, promising to arrange the best viewing seats for you… completely disregarding whether you agreed or not.

Description.SourceString: 查看<blue>格思里的短信</>
Description.LocalizedString: Check <blue>Gethrie's Message</>

PanelDescription.SourceString: 格思里的行动比想象中还要迅速。转眼间，她已经准备好了一切。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Gethrie moved faster than expected. In the blink of an eye, she had everything ready.

Description.SourceString: 前往<blue>赛道起点</>
Description.LocalizedString: Go to the <blue>Race Track Starting Point</>

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: （感觉无视她会更麻烦……还是去现场一趟，把话好好说清楚吧。）
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: (I feel like ignoring her would just cause more trouble… I should go and clear things up properly.)

PanelDescription.SourceString: 格思里报名参加了今晚的未闻浦环线赛。事已至此，还是先赴约吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Gethrie signed up for tonight's race in the Unheard Shores Circuit. Things have come this far, so might as well keep the appointment…

Description.SourceString: 与<blue>格思里</>交谈
Description.LocalizedString: Talk to <blue>Gethrie</>

PanelDescription.SourceString: 比赛结束后，格思里似乎还沉浸在兴奋当中……
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: After the race ended, Gethrie still seems to be caught up in the excitement…
